package main
import("context";"encoding/json";"fmt";"io";"os";"ponder.local/ponder-go/config")
func main(){
 raw,err:=io.ReadAll(os.Stdin);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 base,err:=config.ParseSourceConfiguration(raw);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 _=context.Background;_=json.Valid
input:=struct{Network config.SourceChainSelection;ABI json.RawMessage;Address config.SourceOption[any];StartBlock config.SourceUndefinedBound;EndBlock config.SourceUndefinedBound;Filter config.SourceOption[any];IncludeTransactionReceipts config.SourceOption[bool];IncludeCallTraces config.SourceOption[bool]}{Network:config.SourceOnChains(config.SourceChainOverride{Name:"mainnet"},config.SourceChainOverride{Name:"optimism"}),ABI:json.RawMessage("[{\"name\":\"Event0\",\"type\":\"event\",\"inputs\":[{\"type\":\"bytes32\",\"name\":\"arg\",\"indexed\":true}]}]")}
typed:=config.SourceTypedConfiguration[struct{Network config.SourceChainSelection;ABI json.RawMessage;Address config.SourceOption[any];StartBlock config.SourceUndefinedBound;EndBlock config.SourceUndefinedBound;Filter config.SourceOption[any];IncludeTransactionReceipts config.SourceOption[bool];IncludeCallTraces config.SourceOption[bool]}]{Base:base,Name:"a",Contract:input}
built,err:=config.BuildSourceConfig(base,config.SourceBuildOptions{});if err!=nil{panic(err)}
indexing,err:=config.SafeBuildTypedSourceIndexing[config.SourceUndefinedBound,config.SourceUndefinedBound](context.Background(),typed,built,[]config.SourceIndexingFunction{{Name:"a:Event0",Fn:func(){}}});if err!=nil{panic(err)}
 if len(indexing.EventCallbacks())!=2{panic("actual typed chain/callback result changed")}
 fmt.Println("actual typed source pipeline passed")
}
